description.narrative: THE PROGRAM WILL CONSIST OF THE FOLLOWING COMPONENTS: (A)ENVIRONMENTAL SANITATION IN THE AREA OF TODOS LOS SANTOS; (B)CONTROL OF INDUSTRIAL POLLUTION; (C)AN ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN: (D)DEVELOPMENT OF A DETAILED DIAGNOSTIC OF THE BAY AND THE AREA OF THE PROJECT; (E)A POSSIBLE COMPONENT OF SOLID WASTE REMOVAL FOR THE MUNICIPALITIES ADJACENT TO SALVADOR WHICH ARE NOT INCLUDED IN THE WORLD BANK'S PROGRAM.
